about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Learn about my academic background, professional experience and research areas
about.bioText1: I am a Guest Professor Equivalent to Associate Professor at the University of Minho, where I have been working since 2008 at the School of Economics, Management and Political Science. My career has been dedicated to research, teaching and consulting in critical areas of public administration and management.
about.bioText2: I hold a Ph.D. in Public Management / Political Science (Ph.D.) from the University of Santiago de Compostela, with Portuguese homologation from the University of Porto. I have developed robust research on topics such as public management, social policies, multilevel governance and knowledge management in the public sector.
about.bioText3: My professional experience combines academic perspective with practical application, enabling me to offer specialized consulting services to public and private organizations. I believe that knowledge should generate real impact on society and contribute to evidence-based policymaking.
about.description: One of the leading research centers in Political Science in Portugal, with maximum classification awarded by the Portuguese Science Foundation (FCT) since 2013.

projects.title: Research & Projects
projects.subtitle: Ongoing research initiatives, completed projects and strategic academic partnerships
projects.twoAxesIntro: My research is organized around two complementary lines within Political Science: the study of football as an identity-based and cultural phenomenon, and the analysis of governance and public administration. Both share the same underlying interest — understanding how power is exercised and organized in contemporary societies.
projects.axisFootballDesc: Current research axis, focused on analyzing football as a social and political laboratory. The flagship output of this line is the book
projects.axisFootballDescEnd: , featuring 21 international case studies on nationalism, collective memory and power.
projects.axisFootballThemes: Thematic focus: nationalisms and regionalisms · historical memory and collective rituals · geopolitics and supporter activism · institutional power in clubs and national teams.

projects.axisPublicDesc: Long-standing research line on governance, public administration and social policy, with active and ongoing output.

book.title: A Bola e a Bandeira
book.subtitle: Football, politics and identity in the world
book.author: Nuno Ribeiro e Silva
book.description: Behind every shirt, every flag in the stands and every chant sung by supporters lies a story of identity, power, memory and conflict.
book.longDescription: The book is organized as a sequence of case studies — one chapter, one club, one country — spanning Israel, the United Kingdom, Germany, Spain, Italy, the Balkans, Turkey, and Argentina. Hapoel Tel Aviv, Celtic, St. Pauli, Liverpool, FC Barcelona, Rayo Vallecano, or Fenerbahçe: in each chapter, a club reveals how disputes over social class, nationalism, religion, ethnicity, historical memory, authoritarianism, and democracy condense. This is not a book about results, transfers, or tactics.
book.pullQuote: Each chapter can be read independently, yet all contribute to a shared reflection on what football reveals about the societies that produce it.
